question: Which team clinched the 2019-20 the Vijay Hazare Trophy for the 4th time by defeating Tamil Nadu in the final?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vijay Hazare Trophy** is also called **Ranji One day Trophy** named after **famous Indian cricketer Vijay Hazare former captain (1952-53).**
 
• **Karnataka **won the final in **Vijay-Hazare Trophy of session 2019-20 by beating Tamil Nadu by 60 runs**, with **Abhimanyu Mithun taking a hat-trick.**
 
• **Karnataka** has won its **4th time by beating Tamil Nadu **in the final and also the **second most successful team in this trophy.**
 
• The most successful team of this trophy is **Tamil Nadu which has won 5 times.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Most runs by a batsman in season 2019-20 - **Devdutt Padikkal.**
 
• Most wickets by a bowler in season 2019-20 - **Pritam Das.**
